assessment.summary: This conference abstract describes experiments investigating larval time-to-hatch and resistance to various insecticides in the GAH laboratory colony of Anopheles gambiae from Obuasi, Ghana. While L1014F kdr, rdl, and ace-1 mutations are mentioned as being associated with resistance, no quantitative genotype numbers or frequencies are reported, and testing was performed strictly on a laboratory colony.
